name: CreateWorkItemNode
label: Create Work Item
description: Creates a new work item in the specified queue.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: QueueName
fields.label: Select Queue
fields.description: Choose the queue in which to create the work item.

fields.name: Description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional description for the work item.

fields.name: WorkItemData
fields.label: Work Item Data
fields.description: Provide the data for the work item in JSON format.

fields.name: IsRetry
fields.label: Is Retry
fields.description: Specifies whether to re-attempt an existing work item. When enabled, creates a subsequent attempt linked to the source item with an incremented attempt count, calculated delay, and execution lineage.

fields.name: SourceWorkItemId
fields.label: Source Work Item ID
fields.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the original work item to retry. Required to maintain execution lineage and history.

fields.name: RetryTimeUnit
fields.label: Retry Time Unit
fields.description: The unit of time (Minutes, Hours, or Days) used to delay processing for this retry attempt.

selectOptions.label: Minutes
selectOptions.description: Schedules the retry delay in minutes from the current time.

selectOptions.label: Hours
selectOptions.description: Schedules the retry delay in hours from the current time.

selectOptions.label: Days
selectOptions.description: Schedules the retry delay in days from the current time.

fields.name: RetryTimeValue
fields.label: Retry Time Value
fields.description: The delay duration in selected time units before this retry attempt becomes available for processing. Must be 1 or greater.

fields.name: FileUrls
fields.label: File URLs
fields.description: Optional URLs of files associated with the work item, separated by commas.
